stay, i meant. take care, i said.
there was another sentence after goodbye.
i was not tired that tuesday.
the apology remained in my coat.
you asked once. i answered around it.
the boat was ready. i stayed ashore.
i knew where the keys were.
the phone lit the empty kitchen.
i wanted you to ask again.
the dog waited by the wrong door.
i did come back. just not in time.
